tf32_numerical_impact.verdict: 3% relative error — unacceptable for strict fp32; TF32 disabled

frozen_probe_encoding.note: Encoder frozen, no_grad. Feature precomputation is volume-by-volume (batch=1). chunk_size only affects how many slices are batched per forward pass.

recommendation.reason: chunk_size=100 maximizes throughput at only 1653 MB; batch_size=256 is for cached feature training (75 MB), not encoding

partial_freeze.note: batch_size=1 volume. frozen_blocks = number of first N blocks frozen (of 12 total). Memory scales with num_slices × trainable_blocks.

full_finetune.note: Fits in 24GB with 5GB headroom. Use accum_steps=4 for effective batch=4.

partial_finetune_fast.note: 46% faster than full FT, 50% memory. Sweet spot for speed vs adaptation.

frozen_meanpool_mirage_ep*.yaml.verdict: SAFE. batch_size=256 applies only to probe training on cached features (~75 MB). Encoding is always batch_size=1 volume with chunk_size=50 slices (994 MB peak). No OOM risk.
frozen_meanpool_mirage_ep*.yaml.autocast_location: precompute_features() line ~362 uses autocast() during encoding

gradient_checkpointing: NOT SUPPORTED. src/models/vision_transformer.py has no checkpoint/grad_checkpointing flag.
